# Written by Moose. Do not edit the status line — only Kelly approves, only Moose updates status.

Fort William is officially the Outdoor Capital of the UK. Turns out its gluten-free scene has been training just as hard.

It scored 7/10 on my GF safety scale, and three of its five restaurants scored a perfect 5/5. Quick context: my scores grade celiac safety, not deliciousness — and 5/5 isn't a dedicated-only club; any restaurant that earns all five categories gets there.

→ Ben Nevis — the UK's tallest mountain. Fog at the summit for me; on the way down, Loch Linnhe glittering below.
→ Browns at the Nevis Bank Inn — 5/5, and the GF chocolate tart was INCREDIBLE.
→ The Geographer — 5/5, lively high-street spot, my pick for GF calamari.
→ Nevis Bank Inn — where I stayed; the team packed me a GF lunch for the Ben Nevis hike. Booking link in the guide.

Also in the guide: Crannog, a researched 5/5 that got away, and the Glenfinnan Viaduct — which I rode the train right over and forgot to look at. A personal best.

The full guide is on the site (link in bio). Verdict: come for the mountain. If your hotel packs you a GF summit lunch, you've already won.
